text.p: Severe flooding is ongoing in the US North Plains across many river systems. Milder temperatures are quickening snowmelt and producing even more severe flooding. Many rivers are at all-time record crests. Similar conditions are developing in southern Manitoba, Canada, where the worst flooding in many years is expected to occur. No heavy rain or snow is forecast for these areas during the next 3 to 5 days.

Typhoon Isa, with 121 mph winds and gusts to 160 mph, is well southwest of Guam near 13.1n/139.4e, moving west at about 10 mph. Isa is a major threat to shipping but no longer threatens the islands. Isa is expected to weaken slowly, turning towards the north over the next 48 hours.

Tropical Cyclone Ian, with 63 mph winds, is over the southern Pacific near 20.8s/179.3e. Ian is moving east southeast at 20 mph and is expected to continue this track, weakening, and dissipating over the next 48-72 hours.
